questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: Online content with harmful ideas about masculinity and its effect on a young man
How young men can find jobs using social media
Why boys should learn ballet and poetry
A new website created to help young men
questions.why: They discuss 'the manosphere' and hear from Will Adolphy, who followed it until he had a breakdown.

questions.q: According to Anita Rani's definition, what does the manosphere say makes a man valuable?
options: Kindness, patience and caring for his wife and children
Being creative and artistic
Being honest about his feelings
Control, money, looks and dominance over women
questions.why: She lists emotional control, material wealth, physical appearance and dominance over women.

questions.q: Where, according to Phil, can the manosphere be found?
options: On one popular website
Mainly in newspapers, magazines and on television programmes
In social media posts, videos and other online content
In books written by psychologists
questions.why: He says there's no manosphere website, but its ideas appear in social media posts and TikTok videos.

questions.q: Why does Will Adolphy mention that he did ballet, acting and poetry?
options: To show he was very popular at school
To explain why he didn't fit in and was easily picked on
To say what he does for a job now
To show the kind of activities that the manosphere tells boys to do
questions.why: He says he 'didn't quite fit in the box' and was 'an easy target'.

questions.q: What does Will say about photos of himself at 14?
options: He looked happy and relaxed
He looked much younger than he was
He was always smiling and laughing with his friends
He can see he was hiding behind a mask
questions.why: He says in pictures of him at 14 'you can see bravado, you can see a mask'.

questions.q: What problems did Will have behind his confident image?
options: He found it hard to get a girlfriend or keep a job
He failed all his school exams
He lost contact with his family
He spent all of his money on expensive online courses about success
questions.why: Georgie says he struggled to get a girlfriend or hold down a job.

questions.q: How did the message 'The world hates men' affect Will?
options: He thought it was a joke
He started to see the world as men against everyone else
He decided to stop going online
He reported the influencer to the police and to the social media company
questions.why: He says it felt true and distorted his worldview, so 'it was an us versus them'.

options: He makes videos as an online influencer to help other young men like him
He works as an actor in London
He visits schools, telling young people to question online content
He writes poetry about mental health
questions.why: Phil says he visits UK schools telling his story and reminding young people to question online content.
